test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

A - B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’,

A # B means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

How is P related to F if ‘F - E # L × Q - P # N’
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 -
 ×
 ÷
 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 Daughter
 
 

 to B
 
 

Given: F - E # L × Q - P # N

F - E → F is the brother of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdc13dabfc876d0072b18bc7c06111d9e22e4ee482a7c28a09e5d81b692ffb6c.png] 

E # L → E is the daughter of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d7c69d4b2ccc69c4035c35950790368ef063e49989d7663f8a0d378b0ea772d.png] 

L × Q → L is the wife of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6efa90f776a41fc71f7a2cc9068ae83515b59e4d9b38577b5b71d48f792fa777.png] 

Q - P → Q is the brother of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/100bf6b4798d4ff93e1770780da9667e8751fbb7512bbeaf3eb5c7546e71cd51.png] 

P # N → P is the daughter of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd8c02ca38faaf3b7a6647705e5a1c500d30d435b21baf1dd52929f6472394d3.png] 

Thus, P is F's paternal aunt or father's sister.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
